caption: Kar. 111. Altar
labels: sic, over the second group of line 1 (the o of the second 'so')
sic, by line 3, over the first sign (a)
reading: wo so so ri yi : yoke(2)mln : to ssorlito (3)ato mḫ ps?te : sr(4)ẖ psilke attẖ(5)ḫll pt[.]ke
notes: Line 1: Griffith marks the second 'so' sic (expected wos(i) : soreyi). The group read 'ri' is a w-shaped r joined to a 4-shaped sign, the same group as in 'teri(ke)' of Kar. 112; expected e here. Line 2: first group could be //// = y followed by k (yke); the k has a long tail under the slash. 's?i' (2) could be w+i if the 3-shape is the loop w. The ':' before 'to' may be the dot of to. 3-shaped signs read s by default: m, ẖ or s cannot be told apart reliably here. Line 3 starts with a (sic); 'aḫmḫpste' is read sign by sign, perhaps a corrupt 'at mḫe p(i)sḫ(e)te'. Line 4: '3·ʂ·ʂ' read m? t t?; the two S-shaped signs after ḫ read e? l?; last sign 'a?' is an S plus a long-tailed sign (a, or e + k). One hatched gap of about one sign.
check_notes: Names table, Indexes A-C and formulae A, F, G all found. 'ato' taken from the type although the copy draws the second sign like the c-shaped ḫ (Griffith's sic stands over the a). ps?te keeps Griffith's printed (?). 'yoke(2)mln': the 3-shape is m and the hooked 4-shape l, as the type shows. Final 'ke' is the S + long-tailed sign read a? in step 1 (e + k). Index C 'tewide' (n. BB, Kar. 111) not found.

caption: Kar. 112. Stela with male figure in relief (Kar. Cem., Pl. 11, C. 40265)
notes: Many hatched stretches; dotted stretches counted dot by dot (7 and 5). Line 2 group 1: rightmost sign is a b with a long flat arm (as in beliloke of Kar. 116); a single dot stands between 's' and the y of line 6, not counted as a divider. 'yel?m(9)dlo' is probably yetmde-lo with the t drawn without its dot and e omitted; read as drawn. Line 4: 'woñ?' = loop w, o, crossed sign (ñ). 'teri(14)kel' is terikelowi; the two S-shapes after k are read e l; the following hooked 4-shape is read l (hooked 4 = l elsewhere on these pages); the hatched end shows a 4-like sign (15), a loop (w?) and a 4 (i?). 'pi' after se: angular long-tailed sign read p (could be k).
check_notes: All 12 entries placed. womnits: Griffith brackets [w(?)om] (restored); the copy has three faint marks there, kept with ?. yeseqorbe: the 3 with two strokes is q + o. yetmdelo: the copy shows the t without its dot and only one sign between d and o, so 'dlo' kept (type delo). Copy shows more dotted lost signs (7 and 5) than the type's 3 and 3, and a hatched slot between a and r of 'aromelito'; the copy's [.] after r and m are Griffith's restored o and e(?). Lines 13-15 (terikelowi) have no entry.

caption: Kar. 113. Stela
notes: Different, more angular hand from the other Karanog copies; values are guesses by shape. Line 1 right to left: an H-like sign with a hook (b?), a curly brace-like sign (p?), a Y-shaped sign (b?), a closed D-shaped loop (w?), stroke (o), dotted Gamma (t?); after a gap: stroke (o), N-shaped sign (b?), upright stroke (o?), an angle with a long foot (ḫ? or b). Line 2: V with two strokes (se), 3 (s?), hook (l?), looped d-shape (d, as in the Kar. column of the table), stroke (o), hook (l?), 3 (s?).
check_notes: The names table gives line 1 only as an italic Egyptian name (P-šr-Mr? sy P-a·ṭe-'S): line 1 of the copy is in another script (Demotic), so its step-1 Meroitic values are dropped from the reading. Line 2 = semldolẖ (Index C, names table person 2); last sign a 3 with long descender, ẖ? as the typist doubts.

caption: Kar. 114. Altar
reading: wosi : so(2)reyi : s?ns(3)ye qowi : yetremli : te(4)dḫli : tedḫlowi : tbiḫemye : (5)terikelowi : ato : mẖe : (6)pisoẖekete : (7)at mẖe (8)pisiḫrke(9)te : ḫmlol : pisoẖeke(10)te : wosi : soreyi :
notes: 'sns' at the start of line 3 group: 3, n (rising stroke, loop, long tail), 3; the 3-shapes could be m or ẖ. 'qowi': slash+closed 3 read q (could be s+o). tedḫli / tedḫlowi: the sign after ḫ is small and flat-topped, read l (no e); if it is e read tedḫeowi. In pisoẖekete the slash+3 after 'pi' is read s o (could be q), and the following 3 with a tail is read ẖ. Line 7/8 has a different spelling 'pisiḫrkete' (4, c-shape, w-shape). Line numbers placed over the sign they stand above.
check_notes: All 17 entries placed and agree except the two names now corrected (s to m in yetremli and tbiḫemye; the type prints ')' m). Index C typing 'tbiḫẖye' is wrong: the page shows tbiḫemye.

caption: Kar. 115. Stela (Kar. Cem., Pl. 20, No. 7107)
reading: wosi : sor(2)yi : qo : mpot(3)we?qowi : ato : (4)ẖe : pisoẖeke(5)te? : ḫmlol ẖol : k[.](6)te
notes: Line 1: 'qo' between dividers is two strokes and a closed 3 (could be s o o). The name group: rounded long-tailed sign (k?), angular long-tailed sign (p), stroke, dotted hook (t), closed loop (w) under (3), a small slashed s-shape (l?). Line 2: after 'ato :' only two signs, a 3 under (4) and a ')' shape; expected mẖe, no e visible. te before (5) is hatched but readable. Last group: a 3-shape with a very long curved tail (k?), a hatched sign, te (6).
check_notes: All 11 entries placed. Name is mpotwe(?)qowi (first sign m, not k; e with Griffith's ?). Formula A has 'ẖe' alone (Griffith: 'alone'), so the two signs after ato are ẖ e. Formula C ẖolk[e(?)]te: the copy's lost slot is Griffith's restored e. The copy puts the divider after ẖol, the type after ḫmlol; copy kept.

caption: Kar. 116. Altar
reading: wosi : sorei tpotemser (2)qowi : ilẖmli : tedḫlowi sweibr (3)terikelowi : pesetol : yetmdelo : beli(4)loke : nptel : yetmdelo : beliloke : mnpt : yet(5)mdelowi : ato : mẖe : (6)psiẖte : at : mẖe : (7)psiḫrkte : ḫmlol : ẖol[.]
notes: 'sorei' has no y. Name 'tpotemser': dotted hook (t), angular long-tailed sign (p, could be k), o, te, 7-shape (m), 3 (s?), e, r. 'ilẖmli': 4, hooked small sign (l), 3 with long tail (ẖ?), 7-shape (m), l, i. 'sweibr': 3, loop (w), e, i, a V-shape with long arm (b), r. 'pesetol?': last sign is a small hooked 4-like sign. 'nptel' and 'snpt': n is the rising-stroke R with long tail; the angular long-tailed sign is read p (could be k); in 'snpt' a 3-shape stands before the n. The hooked 4-shape in beliloke is read l (b e l i l o k e). Last group: hatched sign at the end, nothing readable.
check_notes: 26 of 28 entries placed. tpotemserqowi: the type (names table and Index C) prints a closed 3 = s, so s kept. ilẖmli: names table typed s?, Index C ẖ; copy 3 with long tail, ẖ kept. Second beliloke: Index B prints beloloke, but the copy clearly has 4 (i) as in line 4; copy kept. 'beloloke keleb' (Index A) and 'belolokeleb' (Index C) not in this text. nptel: Griffith adds 'sic, for Npte-tel?'.

caption: Kar. 117. Altar
reading: wosi : (2)sorei : nlki(3)dqowi : temeyli : terik?e(4)lowi : kdipoloyi : te?dḫelowi : (5)ant : mnpt : yetmdelowi : (6)snte : mnpt (7): yetm(8)delowi : mlo : (9)mrtowi : ato mẖe : psiẖ : (10)at mḫe psḫrkte : ḫmlol : ẖol[.](11)te : nsedokel : dole : ẖo(12)lkte :
notes: Line 1 name: n with long tail, small hook (l), hatched long-tailed sign (k?), hatching (one sign), d-like sign under (3). Line 2: 'tes?eyli': te, bold 3, small S (e or l), ///, l, i. The k of terikelowi is hatched. Line 3 group 1 right to left: 3 with a long curling tail (ẖ?), d-like sign, 4, angular long-tailed sign (p), a stroke with a small flag (i?), S, stroke, ///, 4; a small hatched mark follows, taken as a damaged divider; the te of tedḫelowi is hatched. (7) stands over the divider after the second 'snpt'; (10) over the divider before 'at'. 'mḫe' and 'psḫrkte' in line 10 have a c-shaped ḫ. Last line: 'ñ?' = a crossed sign after a stroke; last group ends in slash + barred 3 read te?.
check_notes: All 34 entries placed. Step-1 'ato : mẖe' had a divider the copy does not show (re-checked); removed, as in the type. ẖolkte (line 11): the copy shows ẖ o l, a hatched sign and te; the hatched sign is Griffith's k, kept as [.]. nlkidqowi: the copy's hatched sign is Griffith's i. The crossed sign read ñ? is d in the type (nsedokel, dole).
